I'm sorry, Fatima, but I'm not able to place a new order for you — ordering new products isn't something I can handle in this chat. I can only help with things like updating your account or profile, modifying/cancelling existing orders, and returns or exchanges on delivered orders.

As for the address update, I'd love to switch your default address to your new Phoenix home, but I do need the complete street address (street number and name, plus any apartment/unit) along with the city, state (AZ), and zip code to do that. Right now I only have the zip (85033), which isn't enough on its own.

Once the moving truck surfaces the street name, just share the full address and I'll get it updated right away! 🌵
